messages:
jess: Heads-up — saw weird spikes in the console sparklines tied to a recent config rollout. Spikes only appear for cohorts >50% :thinking_face:

mike: Where are you seeing this? link? :eyes:

jess: https://console.redwood.internal/dash/rollout/123 — filter to model=embedder-v2 and check the token-rate sparkline around 11:30. You can see a sharp jump for 60% and 80% cohorts, not for 10% or 30%.

tara: Hm, sounds like telemetry sampling changed during the rollout and the dashboard is not normalizing by sample_rate.

mike: Could be. Are we double-counting in the aggregator when config becomes partially active?

jess: I dug into the raw events — there are duplicated metric lines for the same request_id when new config is pushed, looks like both old and new path emit until one TTL expires.

alec: If that's true, quick query to confirm (clickhouse):
```
SELECT request_id, arrayJoin(groupArray((timestamp, sample_rate))) AS ev FROM metrics
WHERE route='embedder-v2' AND timestamp > now() - 1h
GROUP BY request_id HAVING length(ev) > 1
LIMIT 10
```

yun: Also check runtime flag propagation: we had a race where the operator publishes the config but the consumer reads a cached copy and emits metrics tagged with both old/new rollout_id for a short window.

paul: ops-bot just posted a deploy at 11:26 — could be coincident: ops-bot: deploy embedder-v2-config@2026-03-18T11:26Z by mike.

jess: Repro steps I used: 1) start with rollout 0% -> 100% in 3 steps (10, 50, 100). 2) watch sparklines. 3) inspect raw events with request_id. There is overlap during the apply window.

mike: I can add a short-term fix: emit metrics only from the evaluation path that holds the definitive rollout_id (the one set after config apply completes). But we need a safe rollout plan for that change.

tara: UX ask: the sparkline tooltip should show the active rollout percent and the sampling rate used for the datapoint. That would make diagnosis easier.

alec: Agreed. For safe rollout: patch the aggregator to dedupe by request_id and keep the highest-confidence tag, then rollout aggregator at 10% -> 50% -> 100% with a monitoring gate. If dedupe is expensive, add a feature flag: `metrics.dedupe_v1`.

yun: Also add a console annotation when the config is applied so dashboards show the exact apply window. We have annotation APIs: POST /api/annotations {rollout_id, start_ts, end_ts, meta}.

paul: I'll add the dashboard annotation for this rollout now and create a follow-up to add tooltip metadata.

jess: Action items: 1) mike to open PR for emit-path guard (short-term). 2) alec to propose the dedupe implementation and rollout plan. 3) tara to file UX ticket for tooltip + rollout percent display. 4) paul to add dashboard annotation and schedule telemetry test.

mike: Opening PR in a few mins — will mark it with canary change and link QA. :+1:

alec: I'll draft the canary steps in the PR description: start 5% aggregator hosts, monitor duplicate_count metric, promote if <1% duplicates for 30m.

yun: FYI we should also add a small e2e that simulates short-lived dual-emission during config apply so this doesn't regress.

jess: Perfect. Thanks team. If anyone sees more odd sparklines, ping here and include the apply window timestamps. :thumbsup:

paul: sgtm. i'll annotate and follow up with a tiny dashboard panel that surfaces sample_rate per-point.

ops-bot: deploy embedder-v2-config@2026-03-18T11:26Z recorded (id: dpl-8a7c).

mike: PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4823 — includes emit guard behind `flags.metrics_emit_guard` and rollout notes.

jess: will review now. :eyes:

(End of thread)
